# Horizon M1 daily7

Horizon is a native Rust client for Minecraft Java 26.3. This build is tuned for Apple Silicon and 8 GB Macs.

## Requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 12 or newer
- About 2 GB free disk space
- Minecraft: Java Edition (your own copy)

## Install with one line (easiest)

Open Terminal (Cmd+Space, type Terminal, Return), paste this and press Return:

```bash
zsh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1/main/install.sh)"
```

It downloads and checks the zip below, then runs the installer. No macOS security warnings. Run it again later to update.

## Or install from the zip

1. Download `Horizon-M1-daily7.zip` below.
2. Unzip it.
3. Right-click `Install Horizon M1.command`, then choose Open. On macOS 15 and newer, if it is blocked: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
4. Choose a look (full, fast or plain), then Microsoft or Offline sign-in.

Full guide: see the README at https://github.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1#readme

## Included mods

AppleSkin, Zoom, FPS Overlay, Minimap Worldmap and Waypoints Reworked, Fullbright, Armor Status, Status Effect HUD, Toggle Sprint, Light Overlay, Chat Heads, Held Item Info, Jade, Dynamic FPS for Rust, Crosshair Indicator, Dynamic Lights, CEM Alias

## Included look

64 resource packs (Fresh Animations family, 3D blocks and plants, Dramatic Skys, UI packs and Horizon compatibility packs) and the MakeUp Ultra Fast shader. Installed by default; the installer also offers a fast or plain look. Pack credits: `LICENSES/PACKS.md`.

Mob fixes in this build: mooshroom mushrooms sit on the back, slimes have a see-through outer layer, and charged creepers show their aura.

Credits and licenses are in the `LICENSES` folder of the zip. Unofficial; not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. No Minecraft assets are included.
